title: Carry on a veterinary practice only at registered premises
what: Carry on a veterinary business, and provide veterinary services, only at premises on the Veterinary Surgeons Board's premises register, unless an exception applies.

sources.title: Veterinary Services Act 2023 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A veterinarian must not provide veterinary services at premises other than registered premises

sources.title: Veterinary Services Act 2023 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A business consisting of, or including, the provision of veterinary services must not be carried on at premises that are not registered premises
